title: Brand3 Finding Generation Contract Audit
core_question: Is Brand3 asking the model to generate intelligent findings from clean evidence, or to rationalize noisy, weak, technical, or entity-mixed inputs into strategic prose?
answer: The current contract often asks the model to rationalize mixed evidence into strategic prose.

pipeline_map.description: Collectors and feature analyzers write raw feature values and optional evidence items.
Feature raw values and evidence items are normalized into Evidence objects.
Evidence objects are grouped by dimension without an eligibility gate.
The LLM generates findings, tensions, and synthesis from dimension evidence pools.
Report narrative persists finding text fields and evidence URLs only.
The renderer displays observation and implication, and conditionally displays Decision space.

finding_failure_taxonomy.description: The prompt requires every finding to state commercial or strategic meaning.
The prompt requires decision-space prose for every finding.
Technical artifacts can become normal narrative evidence.
Owned claims are caveated but still repeatedly converted into implications.
Mixed entities or related surfaces lack a contract before findings are generated.
URL validation filters bad URLs but does not reject findings with no URLs.
Persisted report_narrative cannot reconstruct evidence quality or entity relation.
Rendering can hide generic Decision space but cannot correct the upstream finding.

builtwith_trace_table.likely_evidence: visual_consistency evidence_insights such as local image analysis color groups, whitespace ratio, contrast signal
builtwith_trace_table.why_allowed: Internal technical observations entered the evidence pool as quotes; the prompt required implication and typical_decision.

builtwith_trace_table.likely_evidence: robots.txt URL and context readiness signals
builtwith_trace_table.why_allowed: A URL existed and the prompt asked the model to infer implication and decision space.

builtwith_trace_table.likely_evidence: Kit owned website/self-description, sometimes with no finding-level URL
builtwith_trace_table.why_allowed: Owned self-description is allowed if caveated, but the prompt still requires implication and decision space.

builtwith_trace_table.likely_evidence: BuiltWith intelligence-provider evidence mixed into a builtwith.kit.com run
builtwith_trace_table.why_allowed: Contradictory or mixed dimension evidence was grouped and the model lacked entity state.

root_cause_assessment.primary_root_cause: Evidence eligibility and entity boundary are not defined before finding generation.
secondary_causes: The prompt requires strategic implication for every finding.
The prompt requires typical_decision for every finding.
Validation checks shape and URL allowlist but not evidence eligibility.
Persisted payload drops source and evidence quality metadata.
Renderer suppression improves visibility but does not fix generation.

gemini_3_1_cannot_fix_without_contract_c: technical artifacts presented as narrative evidence

recommended_next_step.action: Specify and implement an offline finding evidence eligibility gate before report finding generation.
